about: A report's layout, read off its tags alone, wherever the file lives (docs/reports-design.md §2), first match wins: the tag's `layout=` (grid or linear), else the legacy `kind=` (dashboard is grid, notebook is linear), else grid when it lists tiles or sets a grid width, else linear. `kind` here is the layout in the legacy vocabulary: `dashboard` for grid, `notebook` for linear. The server (submittedTextKind, over resolveReportLayout) and the SDK reader (readDashboardDocument) each hold the rule, so each side's spec reads this file.

cases.name: no kind and no layout is a notebook
a tag with only a title is a notebook
cases.source:
## artifact { title="x" }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: a tiles list makes a dashboard
a tiles list of only a text tile makes a dashboard
a grid width makes a dashboard
an explicit dashboard wins over the absence of a layout
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=dashboard }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: an explicit notebook wins over a tiles list
layout=grid with no tiles is a dashboard
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=grid }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: layout=linear wins over a tiles list
layout=linear wins over a grid width
cases.source: ## artifact { layout=linear tiles=["a -> v"] } dashboard { columns=12 }

cases.name: layout= wins over a disagreeing kind=dashboard
layout= wins over a disagreeing kind=notebook
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=notebook layout=grid }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: an unknown layout value falls through to kind=
an unknown layout value falls through to the tiles list
an unknown layout value with no tiles falls through to linear
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=wide }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }
